name: Caretalk Health
desc:
Medical Assistant (Remote, W2) | $25/hr | Patient Scheduling and Remote Monitoring Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: CareTalk Health
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
CareTalk Health is a virtual medical practice that runs telehealth programs for healthcare organizations. As a Medical Assistant on their Telehealth Services team, you help make virtual care run smoothly. You'll schedule appointments between patients and providers and send reminders. You'll help set up and follow up with patients who use remote health monitoring devices, which track things like blood pressure or therapy progress from home. You'll keep patient records accurate, answer patient questions, and let the nurse or provider know when a health concern comes up. You may be on camera at any time, and you'll work in Amazon Workspaces through Google Chrome.

Soft Skills
- Warm, clear communication with patients
- Organization and time management
- Attention to detail in records
- Good judgment about when to involve a nurse or provider
- Keeping patient information private
assessment: Given the clinical nature of this role, expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't rule those out.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: The posting lists Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) or relevant clinical experience as preferred, under its Required section, so expect them to look for one or the other.
Preferred Experience: Remote patient monitoring, telehealth, or care coordination experience

Required Skills:
- Comfortable with telehealth platforms and video tools
- Strong communication and the ability to build rapport with patients remotely
- Organized with good time management
- Knowledge of medical terminology
- Familiar with electronic health records (EHR)
- Follows HIPAA and keeps patient information confidential
- Windows or Mac computer (no Chromebooks) with 16 GB RAM and an i5 or Apple Silicon processor
- Wired headphones, a webcam, and ethernet internet at 100 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Is a CMA or has worked in a clinic or doctor's office
- Wants to keep doing patient work but from home
- Can juggle scheduling, records, and patient calls
- Already has a computer that meets the tech requirements

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no medical office or clinical background
- Doesn't have, or can't buy, a computer with 16 GB RAM
- Can't hardwire their internet to the router
- Isn't comfortable being on camera during the workday
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Certified Medical Assistant
- Telehealth support
- Remote patient monitoring
- Appointment scheduling
- EHR documentation
- HIPAA compliance
- Patient engagement
- Care coordination
- Medical terminology
- Virtual care

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your experience as a Medical Assistant or in a clinical support role.
- A patient's home blood pressure reading comes in much higher than usual. What do you do?
- How do you build rapport with a patient you only talk to by phone or video?
- Tell us about a time you managed a busy schedule with lots of moving parts. What was the situation, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
- Tell us about a time you caught an error in a patient record or document. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $25/hr, including weekend and holiday shifts. W2, full-time, 40 hours a week.
-Shift: Five 8-hour shifts Monday through Friday, within 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Central. You can choose a shift that fits, like 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. or 10:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Central. One weekend every 6 to 8 weeks, with the following Monday and Tuesday off.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: No. You need your own Windows or Mac computer (no Chromebooks, Linux, or phones) with Windows 10 or macOS 14 or newer, 16 GB RAM, and an Intel i5, AMD equivalent, or Apple Silicon processor. You also need wired headphones (no built-in mics), a webcam, and ethernet internet at 100 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload. A second monitor is strongly suggested.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is one of the best-paying healthcare roles on the board, and you get to pick a shift within the window. It's a strong fit for a participant with CMA or clinical experience. The tech setup is strict, so confirm a participant's computer and internet before they apply. You may be on camera at any time, and all work must be done from inside the United States. Training length is not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Medical Assistant → Senior Medical Assistant → Care Coordinator → Clinical Operations Coordinator → Telehealth Program Manager. This role builds telehealth, remote monitoring, and patient care coordination skills.
training: Discussed in interview/offer stage- have open availability
